title: Following Christ
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Following Christ means responding to Jesus with faith, obedience, surrender, and lifelong discipleship. The Christian life is not merely believing facts about Jesus, but walking after Him as Lord, Savior, Shepherd, and King.
summary: Following Christ means responding to Jesus with faith, obedience, surrender, and lifelong discipleship. The Christian life is not merely believing facts about Jesus, but walking after Him as Lord, Savior, Shepherd, and King.
christFocus: Jesus Christ calls people to Himself and leads them in the way of life. He does not merely give believers a religious label; He calls them to follow Him, learn from Him, obey Him, depend on Him, and become more like Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Following Christ begins with His call. Jesus does not invite sinners merely to admire Him from a distance. He calls them to come after Him, trust Him, listen to His voice, and walk in His ways.

Discipleship includes surrender. Jesus said that anyone who would come after Him must deny himself, take up his cross daily, and follow Him. This does not mean believers earn salvation by sacrifice, but that saving faith brings a person under the lordship of Christ.

Following Christ guards believers from reducing Christianity to church attendance, religious identity, emotional experience, or private belief without obedience. Those who belong to Christ hear His voice and follow Him, trusting that the Shepherd who calls them also keeps them.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people want the comfort of Jesus without the call of Jesus. They may want forgiveness, peace, blessing, or eternal life while resisting surrender, obedience, repentance, and discipleship.

This doctrine brings clarity to those who feel spiritually stuck. Christian growth is the daily life of listening to Christ’s Word, trusting His grace, obeying His commands, and walking with Him through weakness, suffering, service, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Follow Christ today in the next clear step of obedience. Listen to His Word, turn from self-rule, trust His leadership, and do not separate faith from discipleship. When following Him is costly, remember that the One who calls you also gave Himself for you, walks with you, and will bring His sheep safely home.
